hypotheses.title: Event-Driven News Sentiment Accumulation with Persistent Holding Filter (trade_when)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Information from after-hours corporate news headlines (nws12_afterhsz_sl) diffuses slowly into broader market valuations. Using trade_when(rank(ts_sum(vec_avg(nws12_afterhsz_sl), 60)) > 0.5, power(rank(ts_mean(volume, 5) / ts_mean(volume, 252)), 0.5) + 1, rank(ts_sum(vec_avg(nws12_afterhsz_sl), 60)) < 0.5), we enter volume accumulation positions only when 60-day news sentiment is net positive, and freeze weight changes until news sentiment flips negative. By avoiding day-to-day position rebalancing when sentiment remains favorable, trade_when sharply reduces portfolio turnover while preserving strong directional momentum. Subindustry neutralization isolates firm-specific news drift with self-correlation < 0.35.
confounders: Major macroeconomic announcements (e.g. FOMC rate decisions) that override single-stock headline tone
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if event-driven news accumulation yields Sharpe < 1.25 or Fitness < 0.50 in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: trade_when operator entering volume surge with +1 leverage boost on positive 60-day news sentiment and holding until sentiment turns negative.

hypotheses.title: Smooth Logistic News Sentiment Activation with Volume Surge Synergy (sigmoid & ts_zscore)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Standard binary step functions (> 0.5 ? +1 : 0) suffer from knife-edge turnover when news sentiment hovers near the median. Replacing the step function with a smooth logistic transformation (sigmoid(ts_zscore(vec_avg(nws12_afterhsz_sl), 60))) maps rolling 60-day news sentiment z-scores continuously onto the (0, 1) interval. Stocks with explosive positive news get an asymptotic +0.90 to +0.99 boost, neutral news gets +0.50, and negative news gets +0.05. Combining this smooth activation with square-root compressed relative volume surges (power(rank(ts_mean(volume, 5) / ts_mean(volume, 252)), 0.5)) provides continuous long/short differentiation under subindustry neutralization, eliminating threshold churn and driving Fitness > 1.20.
confounders: High-frequency news clustering around scheduled earnings releases that temporarily inflates sentiment z-scores
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if sigmoid news activation yields Sharpe < 1.25 or Fitness < 0.50 in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: Continuous non-linear multi-factor composite combining relative volume surge rank with smooth sigmoid logistic activation of 60-day news sentiment z-score.

hypotheses.title: Informed News-Volume Co-Movement with Contrarian Social Media Buzz (ts_corr & scl12_buzz)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: ts_corr(vec_avg(nws12_afterhsz_sl), volume, 60) measures the rolling 60-day correlation between news sentiment and trading activity. A positive correlation signals informed institutional participation: institutions trade aggressively on positive headlines and withdraw on negative news. When this informed news-volume co-movement is above median (rank > 0.5), pairing it with contrarian social media buzz (-ts_decay_linear(ts_backfill(scl12_buzz, 10), 10)) exploits institutional accumulation occurring before retail hype inflates social buzz. The ternary +1 leverage boost rewards uncrowded institutional accumulation under subindustry neutralization with self-correlation < 0.35.
confounders: Viral retail meme-stock campaigns that distort social media buzz independent of fundamental news flow
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if news-volume correlation with contrarian buzz yields Sharpe < 1.25 or Fitness < 0.50 in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: Ternary leverage boost triggered when rolling 60-day news-volume correlation exceeds median, allocating to contrarian decayed social buzz.
